title: Practice 2: The family of свет (освети́ть, свеча)

blocks.text: Sentences and their English: Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR). Words, meanings and how each word is built: the English Wiktionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: I can't see in this light.
exercises.why: **освещением** — освеще́ние: lighting; illumination; elucidation; coverage (e.g. in the press). Wiktionary: освети́ть + -е́ние.
exercises.context: One family: which of its words fits?

exercises.context: One family: which of its words fits?

exercises.context: One family: which of its words fits?

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: света́ть — (impersonal) to dawn; о́тсвет — reflection, reflected light, glow, gleam; освети́ться — to light up, to brighten; светово́й — (relational) light.
**осветилось** — освети́ться (perfective): to light up, to brighten. Wiktionary: освети́ть + -ся.
exercises.context: One family: which of its words fits?

exercises.q: Ahead, a clearing among the trees appeared.
exercises.why: **просвет** — просве́т: clear space, ray of light (in the clouds); ray of hope; (on shoulder strap) space; (engineering) gap.
